sql: SELECT c.key AS component, r.version, r.status, coalesce(r.fingerprint,'-') AS fingerprint, coalesce(r.activated_at::text,'-') AS activated_at, coalesce(r.retired_at::text,'-') AS retired_at, coalesce(r.pr_ref,'-') AS pr_ref FROM platform_revisions r JOIN platform_components c ON c.id=r.component_id ORDER BY c.key, r.id
